# What would leasing your land for hunting actually net you?

> Free hunting lease income calculator for landowners: compare a flat club lease, per-hunter seasonal leases and paid day hunts after insurance, upkeep and lost use, and see the break-even rate per acre. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
